requirements.title: Administrators shall be able to create, update filtering policies, allow approved exceptions, investigate repeated access attempts to blocked resources, and temporarily restrict users when suspicious behavior is detected.
requirements.statement: Administrators shall be able to create, update filtering policies, allow approved exceptions, investigate repeated access attempts to blocked resources, and temporarily restrict users when suspicious behavior is detected.

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator creates a new filtering policy for staff
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives the policy configuration request
acceptance_criteria.then: The policy is stored and applied to staff user sessions
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of policy creation and application confirmation

acceptance_criteria.given: The system detects repeated access attempts
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects repeated access attempts
acceptance_criteria.then: The system triggers an investigation workflow
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the observed result

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator approves an exception for a specific domain
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives the exception request
acceptance_criteria.then: Access to that domain is permitted for the specified user or group
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of approved exception and access grant
